# Synthetic factory fixtures

Byte-for-byte copies from `docs/product/fixtures/bug-request-v1/` at merged public commit `4be0c93f94a8582b998383c70d10837ba49c8014` (bug-request/1 revision 3, test controls only). The [public backend handoff](https://github.com/Erik-1259/random-bug-walk/pull/150#issuecomment-6419181966) pins this merged revision for local synthetic integration, not hosted or production acceptance. Every JSON file is checked for exact source bytes and parsed with the shared validator, including revision-3 test evidence; no fields are stripped. These are invented test inputs, not live execution evidence. The shared schema validator is used only in tests; the browser imports client-safe types and constants.
